source_of_truth: The frozen judge-only reference dossier; candidates answer from internal knowledge.
evaluation_principles: Require stage-specific diagnosis rather than treating RAG as one component.
Keep correctness, evidence support and citation coverage distinct.
Reward evaluation designs that can localize failures and trade-offs.

key_facts.label: RAG does not guarantee grounding
key_facts.expected: Explains that retrieval conditions generation but neither forces evidence use nor eliminates hallucination.

key_facts.label: Retrieval-stage failures
key_facts.expected: Covers corpus, chunking, indexing, query and ranking failures separately from generation.

key_facts.label: Generator-stage failures
key_facts.expected: Covers ignored, miscombined, contradicted or supplemented evidence even when the answer passage is present.

key_facts.label: More context can hurt
key_facts.expected: Explains distractors, position effects and the precision-recall or latency trade-off of increasing top-k.

key_facts.label: Correctness versus grounding
key_facts.expected: Distinguishes a true answer from a claim supported by the supplied evidence.

key_facts.label: Citation precision and completeness
key_facts.expected: Checks whether citations entail attached claims and whether all material claims needing support are covered.

key_facts.label: Stage-specific metrics
key_facts.expected: Separately measures retrieval recall or ranking and end-to-end answer, grounding, abstention and latency.

key_facts.label: Adversarial and absent-evidence cases
key_facts.expected: Includes unanswerable, contradictory or distractor-rich tests and evaluates abstention rather than assuming it works.

key_ideas.label: Pipeline observability
key_ideas.expected: Localizes failure to corpus, retrieval, context construction or generation.

key_ideas.label: Claim-level evidence contract
key_ideas.expected: Evaluates material claims against their cited evidence rather than trusting fluency or link presence.

key_ideas.label: Factorial evaluation
key_ideas.expected: Varies answerability, evidence presence, rank, position and distractors to reveal causal weaknesses.

key_ideas.label: Mitigation follows failure stage
key_ideas.expected: Maps corpus, retrieval, context and generation interventions to measured failure modes and costs.

known_critical_errors.description: Claims RAG or source links guarantee that generated claims are factual and supported.
Claims increasing top-k or context size can only improve answers.
Treats factual correctness and support by retrieved evidence as the same property.
Evaluates only final answer fluency or exact match and calls the RAG system grounded.
Assumes any displayed citation supports the attached claim without entailment or coverage checking.

anchors.25: No material RAG, retrieval or evaluation error.
anchors.20: Accurate overall with one minor imprecision.
anchors.12: At least one major error or several meaningful imprecisions.

anchors.10: Connects failure stages to discriminating tests, metrics and mitigations.
anchors.7: Sound explanation with one underdeveloped connection.
anchors.4: Lists metrics or techniques without a coherent diagnostic design.

anchors.10: Consistently distinguishes truth, support, completeness and uncertainty.
anchors.7: Mostly calibrated with one limited overstatement.

anchors.10: Clear German, descriptive structure and useful to an AI practitioner.

anchors.5: High information density without material repetition.
anchors.0: Exceeds the hard maximum or is not focused.
